apps.shortDescription: A simple, modern word processor for creating, editing, and formatting documents.
apps.longDescription:
Documents is a simple, modern word processor built for CleraOS.

Create and edit documents without the complexity of traditional office suites. Documents focuses on the tools you actually need for everyday writing while keeping the interface clean, familiar, and easy to use.

 ✍️ Write and edit.

 Create documents for notes, assignments, reports, letters, and everyday writing. Edit your content naturally with familiar text-editing tools.

 🎨 Format your documents.

 Apply formatting to your text and structure your documents without having to navigate through complicated menus or workflows.

 ⚡ Simple by design.

 Documents isn’t trying to be a full enterprise office suite. It focuses on making writing and document editing straightforward, fast, and accessible.

Write. Edit. Format. Done.
apps.name: Documents

apps.shortDescription: An intelligent workspace for thinking, researching, organizing ideas, and getting things done on CleraOS.
apps.longDescription:
Cortex is an intelligent workspace built for CleraOS.

Designed to help you think, research, organize information, and work through ideas, Cortex brings intelligent assistance into your everyday computing environment.

 🧠 Think and explore.

 Use Cortex to explore ideas, ask questions, work through problems, and turn scattered thoughts into something useful.

 🔎 Research and understand.

 Bring information together and use Cortex to help you understand, summarize, analyze, and explore what you’re working with.

 ✍️ Work with your ideas.

 Whether you’re planning a project, developing an idea, studying a topic, or simply trying to make sense of something, Cortex provides a workspace for thinking and exploration.

 🔒 Your workspace.

 Cortex is designed to be part of your CleraOS computing environment rather than another disconnected website you have to switch to.

Think deeper. Explore ideas. Get things done.
apps.name: Cortex
